translations.web: Or else wouldn’t they have ceased to be offered, because the worshipers, having been once cleansed, would have had no more consciousness of sins?
translations.bsb: If it could, would not the offerings have ceased? For the worshipers would have been cleansed once for all, and would no longer have felt the guilt of their sins.
translations.kjv: For then would they not have ceased to be offered? because that the worshippers once purged should have had no more conscience of sins.
